ache.title: “Generous pulls” is still pulls
ache.note: Nero comes back to Aether Gazer after a long break and praises its deity-based characters, smooth PC client and generous pull system. Generous is nicer than stingy, but it still trains you to pull. A gacha that feels kind can lower your guard more than a greedy one.
watch: a comeback that starts with pulls
ache.tip: Enjoy a generous game, but keep the same spending limit you’d keep with a stingy one.
lines: kind slot machines are still slot machines
welcome back. keep your guard up

videoData.title: Aether Gazer in 2024: A New World

textData.text: After a long hiatus, I'm excited to talk about Aether Gazer, a fantastic action gacha game that deserves more attention. In this video, I dive deep into the game's features, including its deity-based characters, smooth PC client, and generous pull system. I'll also show you some combat gameplay and discuss the various modes and events you can participate in. Whether you're into flashy animations or strategic character builds, Aether Gazer has something for everyone. Join me as we explore this game and build an awesome community together!
